name: Alpencamping Gerlos
beschreibung:
Overview

Alpencamping Gerlos is a small, family-run campsite at the Schönachhof in the municipality of Gerlos in the Zillertal valley in Tyrol. It is situated at 1,247 m above sea level, nestled between forest and mountain landscape, and is part of a farm with a bed-and-breakfast. In summer the site comprises around 35 pitches with electricity connections for motorhomes, caravans and tents; for tent enthusiasts, pitches are available on a separate tent meadow. Fresh water is located directly next to the sanitary facilities. According to the operator, the site is particularly suitable for families with children and for guests seeking peace and quiet, and yet it is centrally located: the Zillertal Arena, respectively the Isskogelbahn cable car, is about a five-minute walk away, and the village centre with supermarket and restaurants is around ten to fifteen minutes on foot. The cross-country ski trail runs directly next to the site.

History/Background

The campsite is run by the Schönachhof of the Kammerlander family, a farm with a bed-and-breakfast, rooms and apartments on the edge of Gerlos. According to the operator, the farm is home to cows, ponies, rabbits, chickens and a farm dog, which makes the site particularly attractive for children. The compact sanitary facilities at the campsite were renovated in 2017; in addition, there is a separate chemical toilet, a dishwashing room as well as a washing machine and dryer. Dogs are welcome; a leash requirement applies.

Getting there

The address is Gerlos 242, 6281 Gerlos in Tyrol. The campsite is located on the edge of Gerlos in the Zillertal valley. A public transport stop is around 500 metres away, as is the village centre, also about 500 metres; the Isskogelbahn of the Zillertal Arena can be reached on foot in a few minutes. Arrival by car is via the Zillertal valley to Gerlos; vehicles up to ten metres in length can be parked at the site. The operator provides information about the location and how to get there on its website.

Tips

Reservations are only possible from two nights onwards; in the high season of July and August a minimum stay of four nights applies. The reception is staffed daily from 08:00 to 12:00 and from 14:00 to 19:00; no check-in is possible during the lunch break. The site offers free Wi-Fi, a ski room with a boot dryer as well as a drinks and coffee vending machine. A bread roll service, a playground and a sauna complete the offering. Electricity is provided via 16-amp connections.

Best time to travel

The season extends across summer and winter. The site is closed from mid-October to the beginning of December and from the beginning/mid of April to mid/end of May. The high season is in July and August. In winter, the ski areas of the Zillertal Arena can be reached; in summer, the surrounding area is ideal for hikes and mountain bike tours.
kurzbeschreibung: Small family-run campsite at Schönachhof in Gerlos at 1,247 m above sea level, near the Isskogelbahn cable car, with around 35 pitches and a tent meadow.
